questions.stem: According to the IASB Conceptual Framework, the objective of financial reporting is best described as providing information useful to:

choices.B: users in making decisions about providing resources to the entity
choices.C: management in valuing the company's assets

questions.explanation: The objective: financial information useful to users in making decisions about PROVIDING RESOURCES to the entity (equity, debt, loans, credit) and in influencing management's actions. The named users are resource providers — investors, lenders, other creditors — not tax authorities or management.
questions.kr: 목적: 기업에 '자원을 제공'하는 결정(지분·채무·대출·신용)과 경영진 행동에 영향을 주는 데 유용한 정보. 대상은 자원 제공자(투자자·대여자·채권자)이지 세무당국이나 경영진이 아님.

questions.stem: Financial reporting standards most likely:

choices.A: eliminate the need for judgment in preparing statements
choices.B: ensure a single correct answer for reflecting economic activity
choices.C: limit the range of acceptable answers to increase consistency

questions.explanation: Uncertainty requires accruals and estimates, which require judgment; there 'usually will be no single correct answer'. Standards LIMIT THE RANGE of acceptable answers to increase consistency. A and B are absolute claims the curriculum explicitly rejects.
questions.kr: 불확실성 → 발생주의·추정 → 판단 필요; '보통 단 하나의 정답은 없음'. 기준은 허용 가능한 답의 '범위를 제한'해 일관성을 높임. A·B는 교재가 명시적으로 부정하는 절대적 주장.

questions.stem: Financial reports are best described as:

choices.B: important inputs to valuation but not designed solely for it
choices.C: designed for regulators rather than investors

questions.explanation: Reports serve many users (investors, creditors, employees, customers, others), so they are NOT designed solely for asset valuation — but they provide important INPUTS into valuing a company or its securities.
questions.kr: 보고서는 여러 이용자(투자자·채권자·직원·고객 등)를 위한 것이라 자산 평가만을 위해 설계되지 '않음' — 다만 기업·증권 가치평가의 중요한 '입력값'을 제공.

questions.stem: The impetus for stronger coordination among major standard-setting bodies came most directly from:

choices.B: globalization of capital flows and accounting scandals
choices.C: the shift from principles-based to rules-based standards

questions.explanation: Globalization of capital flows plus accounting scandals created demand for uniform, high-quality global standards → stronger coordination among the major standard-setters. There was no general shift from principles- to rules-based standards.
questions.kr: 자본 흐름의 세계화 + 회계 스캔들 → 통일된 고품질 글로벌 기준 수요 → 주요 기준제정기구 간 협력 강화. 원칙중심 → 규칙중심으로의 전반적 이동은 없었음.

questions.stem: Which of the following best describes the role of regulatory authorities such as the SEC?

choices.A: They set financial reporting standards as private-sector bodies
choices.B: They recognize and enforce standards and retain legal authority to establish them
choices.C: They appoint the members of the IASB

questions.explanation: Regulators are GOVERNMENT bodies with legal authority: they recognize and enforce standards and retain the authority to establish them (and can overrule the setters). Setting standards as private bodies is the IASB/FASB role; IASB members are appointed by the IFRS Foundation Trustees.
questions.kr: 규제기관 = '정부' 기관, 법적 권한: 기준을 인정·집행하고 제정 권한도 보유(기준제정기구를 뒤집을 수 있음). 민간기구로서 기준 제정은 IASB/FASB의 역할; IASB 위원은 IFRS 재단 이사회가 임명.

questions.stem: The authority of a private-sector standard-setting body such as the IASB derives most directly from:

choices.B: recognition of its standards by regulatory authorities

questions.explanation: 'Without the recognition of the standards by the regulatory authorities, the private sector standard-setting bodies would have no authority.' IFRS are authoritative to the extent they are recognized and adopted by regulators. Expertise is how members are chosen, not where authority comes from.
questions.kr: '규제기관의 인정이 없으면 민간 기준제정기구는 아무런 권한이 없다.' IFRS는 규제기관이 인정·채택하는 범위 내에서만 권위를 가짐. 전문성은 위원 선발 기준이지 권한의 원천이 아님.

questions.stem: The members of the IASB are appointed by:
questions.explanation: Layers: monitoring board (public authorities — EC, IOSCO, Japan FSA, US SEC) holds the Trustees accountable → IFRS Foundation Trustees appoint the IASB members. IOSCO sits on the monitoring board; it does not appoint.
questions.kr: 구조: 모니터링 보드(공공기관 — EC, IOSCO, 일본 FSA, 미국 SEC)가 이사회를 감독 → IFRS 재단 이사회(Trustees)가 IASB 위원을 임명. IOSCO는 모니터링 보드 구성원일 뿐 임명하지 않음.

questions.stem: The FASB Accounting Standards Codification is best described as:

choices.A: the source of authoritative US GAAP for non-governmental entities
choices.B: the complete set of SEC regulations and guidance
choices.C: the US equivalent of the IFRS Conceptual Framework

questions.explanation: The Codification, organized by topic, is the source of authoritative US GAAP for non-governmental entities. Only CERTAIN PORTIONS — not all — of SEC guidance are included for reference.
questions.kr: 주제별로 정리된 코디피케이션은 비정부기관에 대한 권위 있는 US GAAP의 원천. SEC 지침은 '일부만' 참고용으로 포함 — 전부가 아님.

questions.stem: With respect to US GAAP, the SEC most likely:

choices.A: has no authority to establish accounting standards
choices.B: retains the authority to establish standards but has rarely overruled the FASB
choices.C: delegates all authority to the Financial Accounting Foundation

questions.explanation: The SEC recognizes FASB standards as authoritative but RETAINS the authority to establish accounting standards and reporting requirements; it has rarely overruled the FASB and issues guidance such as Staff Accounting Bulletins.
questions.kr: SEC는 FASB 기준을 권위 있는 것으로 인정하지만 기준 제정 권한을 '보유'; FASB를 뒤집은 적은 드물며 Staff Accounting Bulletins 같은 지침을 발행.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a fundamental qualitative characteristic under the IFRS Conceptual Framework?
questions.explanation: Two fundamental: RELEVANCE and FAITHFUL REPRESENTATION. Four enhancing: comparability, verifiability, timeliness, understandability (C-V-T-U). Comparability and timeliness are enhancing.
questions.kr: 근본적 특성 2개: 목적적합성, 충실한 표현. 보강적 특성 4개: 비교가능성, 검증가능성, 적시성, 이해가능성(C-V-T-U). 비교가능성·적시성은 보강적.

questions.stem: 'Different knowledgeable and independent observers would agree that the information faithfully represents the phenomenon' best describes:
questions.explanation: That is the definition of VERIFIABILITY (enhancing). Neutrality (part of faithful representation) = without bias; comparability = identify similarities and differences across time and entities.
questions.kr: 이는 '검증가능성'(보강적)의 정의. 중립성(충실한 표현의 하위요소) = 편향 없음; 비교가능성 = 기간·기업 간 유사점과 차이 식별.

questions.stem: Materiality is discussed within the context of:
questions.explanation: Materiality sits INSIDE relevance: information is material if its omission or misstatement could influence users' decisions (nature and/or magnitude). It is not a separate characteristic and not part of faithful representation (complete, neutral, free from error).
questions.kr: 중요성은 목적적합성 '안에' 있음: 누락·왜곡이 이용자 결정에 영향을 줄 수 있으면 중요(성격 및/또는 규모). 별도 특성도, 충실한 표현(완전성·중립성·오류 없음)의 일부도 아님.

questions.stem: The pervasive constraint on useful financial reporting identified in the Conceptual Framework is:
questions.explanation: COST is the one pervasive constraint named — benefits should exceed the costs of providing and using information. Materiality is part of relevance; verifiability is an enhancing characteristic.
questions.kr: 명시된 유일한 포괄적 제약은 '원가' — 정보 제공·이용의 효익이 원가를 초과해야. 중요성은 목적적합성의 일부, 검증가능성은 보강적 특성.

questions.stem: Recording an estimated bad-debt expense at the time of a credit sale most likely sacrifices:
questions.explanation: The estimate is relevant, faithful, timely and understandable — but actual bad debts aren't known until later, so the figure cannot yet be verified by independent observers. Lesson: not all characteristics can be met at once.
questions.kr: 추정치는 목적적합·충실·적시·이해 가능 — 그러나 실제 대손은 나중에야 알 수 있어 독립적 관찰자가 아직 검증할 수 없음. 교훈: 모든 특성을 동시에 충족할 수는 없음.

questions.stem: Under the Conceptual Framework, useful information that is difficult to understand should most likely be:

choices.B: included, since users may seek assistance
choices.C: simplified until no assistance is needed

questions.explanation: Understandability assumes users with reasonable business knowledge who study diligently; useful information should NOT be excluded just because it's complex — users may need to seek help.
questions.kr: 이해가능성은 합리적 지식을 갖고 성실히 검토하는 이용자를 가정; 유용한 정보는 복잡하다는 이유로 제외해서는 '안 됨' — 이용자가 도움을 받을 수 있음.

questions.stem: A company issues new shares for cash. Under the Conceptual Framework this transaction is most likely:

choices.A: income, since assets and equity increase
choices.B: not income, since it is a contribution from equity holders

questions.explanation: Income = increases in assets/decreases in liabilities that raise equity OTHER THAN contributions from equity holders. A share issue raises assets and equity but is an owner contribution, so it is excluded. Dropping the exclusion clause is the trap.
questions.kr: 수익 = 자산 증가/부채 감소로 자본이 늘어나는 것 — 단 '지분 보유자의 출자는 제외'. 유상증자는 자산·자본을 늘리지만 소유주 출자라 제외. 제외 조항을 빠뜨리는 것이 함정.

questions.stem: Under the Conceptual Framework, income most likely:

choices.C: is the same as revenue from ordinary activities

questions.explanation: Income is the broader element: REVENUES (ordinary activities) + GAINS (ordinary or other activities). Likewise expenses include losses. Income ≠ revenue.
questions.kr: 수익(income)은 더 넓은 요소: 영업수익(revenue, 통상활동) + 차익(gains). 비용도 손실을 포함. income ≠ revenue.

questions.stem: Recognizing revenue when performance obligations are satisfied, regardless of when cash is received, reflects the assumption of:
questions.explanation: Accrual accounting: transactions are recorded in the period they occur, not when cash moves; revenue when earned (performance obligations satisfied). Going concern = continues for the foreseeable future; historical cost is a measurement basis, not an assumption.
questions.kr: 발생주의: 현금 이동이 아니라 발생 기간에 기록; 수익은 수행의무 이행 시. 계속기업 = 예측 가능한 미래에 존속; 역사적 원가는 측정기준이지 가정이 아님.

questions.stem: The amount of cash that would have to be paid today to buy an equivalent asset is the asset's:
questions.explanation: CURRENT COST = replacement cost, the BUY (entry) side. Realizable value = cash from SELLING in an orderly disposal; fair value = an EXIT price between market participants. Direction is the discriminator.
questions.kr: 현행원가 = 대체원가, '구입'(진입) 측. 실현가능가치 = 정상적 처분으로 '판매'해 얻는 현금; 공정가치 = 시장참여자 간 '유출' 가격. 방향이 판별 기준.

questions.stem: Which measurement basis for an asset is defined as an exit price in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date?
questions.explanation: FAIR VALUE = the price received to sell an asset (or paid to transfer a liability) in an orderly transaction between market participants at the measurement date — an EXIT price. Current cost is an entry price; PV discounts the entity's own expected cash flows.
questions.kr: 공정가치 = 측정일에 시장참여자 간 정상거래에서 자산을 팔아 받는(부채 이전 시 지급하는) 가격 — '유출' 가격. 현행원가는 진입 가격; 현재가치는 기업 자신의 기대현금흐름을 할인.

questions.stem: Which basis measures a liability at the undiscounted amount expected to be paid in the normal course of business?
questions.explanation: SETTLEMENT VALUE = undiscounted cash expected to settle the liability in the normal course. Only PRESENT VALUE discounts. Fair value is the price to transfer the liability to a market participant.
questions.kr: 결제가치 = 정상적 영업과정에서 부채를 상환하는 데 예상되는 '할인하지 않은' 현금. '현재가치'만 할인. 공정가치는 부채를 시장참여자에게 이전하는 가격.

questions.stem: An item is recognized in the financial statements if it meets the definition of an element and:

choices.A: can be measured at historical cost
choices.B: results in relevant information and a faithful representation

questions.explanation: Two tests, both required: (1) meets an element definition; (2) recognition yields BOTH relevant information AND a faithful representation — the two fundamental characteristics applied as a recognition test.
questions.kr: 두 요건 모두 필요: (1) 요소의 정의 충족; (2) 인식 시 목적적합한 정보 '와' 충실한 표현을 모두 제공 — 두 근본적 특성을 인식 기준으로 적용.

questions.stem: Which of the following is least likely part of a complete set of financial statements under IFRS?

choices.C: The statement of changes in equity

questions.explanation: LEAST-likely stem → T/F each. The notes are 'an integral part' of the complete set (T); the statement of changes in equity is one of the four statements (T). MD&A is SUPPLEMENTARY information in the financial report, not part of the statements (F → answer).
questions.kr: least likely → 선지별 T/F. 주석은 전체 재무제표의 '필수적 일부'(T); 자본변동표는 4개 재무제표 중 하나(T). MD&A는 재무보고서의 '보충' 정보이지 재무제표가 아님(F → 정답).

questions.stem: Which statement reports a company's position at a point in time?
questions.explanation: Only the BALANCE SHEET is a snapshot at a point in time; the comprehensive income, changes in equity and cash flow statements cover a period.
questions.kr: '재무상태표'만 특정 시점의 스냅샷; 포괄손익계산서·자본변동표·현금흐름표는 기간을 다룸.

questions.stem: The external auditor's opinion most likely addresses whether the financial statements:

choices.B: present fairly in accordance with applicable accounting standards
choices.C: reflect the fair value of the company

questions.explanation: The opinion is whether the statements PRESENT FAIRLY the company's performance and position in accordance with a specified set of accounting standards — not a guarantee of accuracy and not a valuation.
questions.kr: 감사의견은 재무제표가 특정 회계기준에 따라 성과와 재무상태를 '공정하게 표시'하는지 여부 — 정확성 보증도, 가치평가도 아님.

questions.stem: Consolidated financial statements include the account balances of:

choices.A: all companies in which the parent holds shares
choices.B: subsidiaries under the control of the parent

questions.explanation: Consolidation includes subsidiaries UNDER THE CONTROL of the parent. Holding some shares without control does not bring a company into consolidation.
questions.kr: 연결재무제표는 모회사가 '지배'하는 종속회사를 포함. 지배 없이 일부 지분만 보유하면 연결 대상이 아님.

questions.stem: In addition to compliance with accounting standards, the external auditor's report typically provides assurance regarding:

choices.B: the functioning of internal controls over financial reporting

questions.explanation: The auditor's report has TWO assurance components: compliance with applicable standards AND that internal controls over financial reporting are functioning. Governance structure is in the governance report.
questions.kr: 감사보고서의 확신은 '두 가지': 회계기준 준수 '그리고' 재무보고 내부통제의 작동. 지배구조는 지배구조 보고서의 내용.

questions.stem: A company reports total assets of 850 and owners' equity of 320. Its total liabilities are closest to:
questions.explanation: A = L + E → L = A − E = 850 − 320 = 530. Choice B adds the two; choice C repeats equity.
questions.kr: A = L + E → L = 850 − 320 = 530. B는 더한 값, C는 자본을 반복.

questions.stem: A company has liabilities of 410 and owners' equity of 190. Total assets are closest to:
questions.explanation: A = L + E = 410 + 190 = 600. Choice A subtracts.

questions.stem: The 'book value' of a company is best described as:

choices.C: the market value of its shares

questions.explanation: Book value = owners' equity = net assets = assets − liabilities, the residual claim. Not total assets, not market value.
questions.kr: 장부가치 = 자기자본 = 순자산 = 자산 − 부채(잔여청구권). 총자산도 시장가치도 아님.

questions.stem: IFRS requires that the balance sheet:

choices.A: present assets in order from most liquid to least liquid
choices.B: show current and non-current assets and liabilities as separate classifications

questions.explanation: IFRS requires the current/non-current CLASSIFICATION but does not prescribe an ORDER — order is largely tradition (Germany least→most liquid with equity first; US/Australia/Canada most→least liquid with cash first).
questions.kr: IFRS는 유동/비유동 '구분'을 요구하지만 '순서'는 규정하지 않음 — 순서는 관행(독일: 유동성 낮은→높은 순, 자본 먼저; 미국·호주·캐나다: 높은→낮은 순, 현금 먼저).

questions.stem: Presenting cash as the first asset and equity after liabilities is the typical order in:

choices.B: the United States, Australia, and Canada

questions.explanation: Most liquid → least liquid (cash first, equity last) is the US/Australia/Canada convention. Volkswagen (Germany) uses least → most liquid with equity before liabilities. IFRS prescribes no order.
questions.kr: 유동성 높은 → 낮은 순(현금 먼저, 자본 마지막)은 미국·호주·캐나다 관행. 폭스바겐(독일)은 낮은 → 높은 순, 자본이 부채 앞. IFRS는 순서를 규정하지 않음.

questions.stem: In Volkswagen's balance sheet, total liabilities are not reported as a single line. An analyst should:

choices.A: treat total liabilities as equal to total equity
choices.B: sum the non-current and current liability subtotals
choices.C: subtract current assets from total assets

questions.explanation: Add the subtotals: 152,726 + 160,389 = 313,115 ≈ €313bn; check 422 = 313 + 109. Also read the column headers — VW puts the most recent year on the left.
questions.kr: 소계를 더함: 152,726 + 160,389 ≈ €313bn; 422 = 313 + 109로 검증. 열 머리글도 확인 — VW는 최근 연도가 왼쪽.

questions.stem: Operating profit is best described as the result of the company's usual business activities:

choices.B: before deducting interest expense or taxes
choices.C: after taxes but before minority interests

questions.explanation: Operating profit (operating income/result) = results of usual business activities BEFORE interest and taxes — hence EBIT. After interest but before tax is EBT; after tax is net income.
questions.kr: 영업이익 = 통상 영업활동의 결과로 이자·세금 '차감 전' — 그래서 EBIT. 이자 후·세전은 EBT, 세후는 순이익.

questions.stem: A parent owns 80% of a subsidiary's voting shares. On the consolidated income statement, the subsidiary's revenue is most likely included at:

choices.B: 100% of the subsidiary's revenue, with 20% of net income allocated to non-controlling interests

questions.explanation: Consolidation includes the ENTIRE amount of each line (control presumed > 50% voting). The ownership split appears only in the attribution at the bottom: 20% of net income to non-controlling interests.
questions.kr: 연결은 각 항목의 '전액'을 포함(의결권 50% 초과 시 지배 추정). 지분 비율은 맨 아래 귀속에서만 반영: 순이익의 20%를 비지배지분에 배분.

questions.stem: Net income attributable to common shareholders is 900 million and the weighted-average number of common shares outstanding is 300 million. Basic EPS is closest to:
questions.explanation: Basic EPS = NI to common ÷ WEIGHTED-AVERAGE common shares = 900 / 300 = 3.00. Choice B inverts the ratio.
questions.kr: 기본 EPS = 보통주 귀속 순이익 ÷ '가중평균' 보통주식수 = 900/300 = 3.00. B는 역수.

questions.stem: Diluted EPS differs from basic EPS most likely because it:

choices.A: uses year-end rather than weighted-average shares
choices.B: assumes potentially dilutive claims such as options and convertibles are exercised
choices.C: excludes income attributable to preferred shareholders

questions.explanation: Diluted EPS uses the shares that would HYPOTHETICALLY be outstanding if options and convertibles were exercised/converted, with the numerator adjusted accordingly. Both measures use weighted-average shares; both use income attributable to common.
questions.kr: 희석 EPS는 옵션·전환사채가 행사/전환된다고 '가정'한 주식수를 사용하고 분자도 조정. 두 지표 모두 가중평균 주식수와 보통주 귀속 이익을 사용.

questions.stem: Net income is 500 and other comprehensive income is −40. Total comprehensive income is closest to:
questions.explanation: Total comprehensive income = NI + OCI = 500 + (−40) = 460. Choice A drops the sign of OCI; choice C ignores OCI.
questions.kr: 총포괄이익 = 순이익 + 기타포괄이익 = 500 − 40 = 460. A는 OCI 부호 누락, C는 OCI 무시.

questions.stem: Which of the following is most likely reported in other comprehensive income rather than net income?

choices.B: Unrealized currency translation gains on foreign operations

questions.explanation: Unrealized currency translation gains/losses are the curriculum's named OCI example (an item that may be reclassified to profit or loss later). Cost of sales and income tax expense are income-statement items.
questions.kr: 미실현 외화환산손익은 교재가 명시한 OCI 예시(나중에 당기손익으로 재분류될 수 있는 항목). 매출원가·법인세비용은 손익계산서 항목.

questions.stem: Comprehensive income includes all changes in owners' equity except those resulting from:
questions.explanation: Comprehensive income = all items affecting owners' equity EXCEPT transactions with shareowners (issuance, buybacks, dividends). FX translation and pension remeasurements are both OCI components, so they are INCLUDED.
questions.kr: 포괄이익 = 주주와의 거래(발행·자사주·배당)를 '제외한' 모든 자본 변동. 외화환산과 연금 재측정은 OCI 구성요소라 '포함'.

questions.stem: Beginning equity 500; net income 80; other comprehensive income −10; dividends paid 30; new shares issued 50. Ending equity is closest to:
questions.explanation: End = Begin + NI + OCI + issuance − dividends = 500 + 80 − 10 + 50 − 30 = 590. Choice A ignores OCI (600); choice C ignores the share issue. All four terms enter — comprehensive income, not net income alone.
questions.kr: 기말 = 기초 + 순이익 + OCI + 발행 − 배당 = 500 + 80 − 10 + 50 − 30 = 590. A는 OCI 무시, C는 신주발행 무시. 네 항목 모두 반영 — 순이익만이 아니라 포괄이익.

questions.stem: The purchase of a new factory is most likely classified in the cash flow statement as:
questions.explanation: Investing = acquisition and disposal of LONG-TERM assets (property, equipment, subsidiaries, equity investments).
questions.kr: 투자활동 = '장기'자산(유형자산·설비·종속회사·지분투자)의 취득과 처분.

questions.stem: Repayment of a bond is most likely classified as:
questions.explanation: Financing = obtaining or repaying CAPITAL used in the business — bonds issued/repaid, capital contributions, dividends paid.
questions.kr: 재무활동 = 사업에 쓰이는 '자본'의 조달·상환 — 사채 발행/상환, 출자, 배당 지급.

questions.concept: Net change in cash — four terms
questions.stem: CFO = 300, CFI = −450, CFF = 200, effect of exchange rates on cash = −20. The net change in cash is closest to:
questions.explanation: Net change in cash = CFO + CFI + CFF + FX effect = 300 − 450 + 200 − 20 = +30. Choice A (+50) stops at the three categories and misses the FX line — the fourth term.
questions.kr: 현금 순변동 = CFO + CFI + CFF + 환율효과 = 300 − 450 + 200 − 20 = +30. A(+50)는 세 활동만 더하고 환율효과(네 번째 항)를 누락.

questions.stem: The method of presenting cash from operating activities that starts with profit and adjusts for non-cash items is the:

choices.A: direct method, used by most companies
choices.B: indirect method, used by most companies
choices.C: indirect method, used by very few companies

questions.explanation: INDIRECT: start with profit, adjust for non-cash items, accruals/deferrals and investing/financing items — used by almost all companies. DIRECT: gross receipts and payments — used by very few.
questions.kr: 간접법: 이익에서 시작해 비현금 항목·발생/이연·투자/재무 항목을 조정 — 거의 모든 기업이 사용. 직접법: 총현금수취·지급 — 극소수만 사용.

questions.front: The IFRS qualitative characteristics: the 2 fundamental (with sub-parts) and the 4 enhancing; the pervasive constraint; the bad-debt trade-off
questions.back:
FUNDAMENTAL: RELEVANCE — predictive and/or confirmatory value; MATERIALITY sits inside relevance (omission/misstatement could influence decisions; nature and/or magnitude). FAITHFUL REPRESENTATION ('reliability') — complete, neutral, free from error (process, not perfect accuracy).
ENHANCING (C-V-T-U): comparability, verifiability (independent observers agree), timeliness (before the decision), understandability (don't exclude difficult info). No priority among enhancing.
Pervasive constraint = COST (benefits > costs). Limitation: non-quantifiables omitted.
Bad-debt estimate: relevant, faithful, timely, understandable — sacrifices VERIFIABILITY.

questions.front: The six measurement bases — asset version and liability version of each; the buy/sell and discounted/undiscounted discriminators
questions.back:
HISTORICAL COST: paid incl. acquisition costs (transport, tax) / proceeds received.
AMORTISED COST: historical adjusted for depreciation, amortisation, depletion, impairment.
CURRENT COST: replacement cost — BUY today / UNDISCOUNTED settle today.
REALIZABLE (SETTLEMENT) VALUE: SELL in orderly disposal / UNDISCOUNTED pay in normal course.
PRESENT VALUE: DISCOUNTED inflows / DISCOUNTED outflows.
FAIR VALUE: EXIT price, orderly transaction, market participants, measurement date.
Current cost = buy side; realizable = sell side; only PV discounts.

questions.front: The five elements with their exclusion clauses, the two assumptions, and the two recognition tests
questions.back:
ASSET: present resource CONTROLLED from past events. LIABILITY: present OBLIGATION to transfer a resource, no practical ability to avoid. EQUITY: assets − liabilities (residual).
INCOME: asset ↑ / liability ↓ raising equity, EXCLUDING owner contributions = REVENUE + GAINS. EXPENSES: the reverse, EXCLUDING owner distributions, incl. LOSSES. (Share issue ≠ income; dividend ≠ expense.)
Assumptions: ACCRUAL (period of occurrence; revenue when performance obligations satisfied) and GOING CONCERN.
Recognition: meets an element definition AND yields relevant info + faithful representation.

questions.front: Standard-setters vs regulators; IASB and FASB structure; where US GAAP lives
questions.back:
SETTERS (IASB, FASB): private, self-regulated; SET standards; authority only via regulator recognition. REGULATORS (SEC, Singapore ACRA, Brazil SEC): government; RECOGNIZE and ENFORCE; legal authority; can overrule setters (SEC rarely does).
IASB: monitoring board (EC, IOSCO, Japan FSA, US SEC) → IFRS Foundation Trustees → appoint IASB members. Process: agenda → advice → exposure draft → standard. Foundation objectives: single high-quality set; transparent, comparable, decision-useful; convergence.
FASB: overseen by the Financial Accounting Foundation; output = Accounting Standards Codification (authoritative US GAAP for non-governmental entities); SEC guidance only partly included; SEC issues Staff Accounting Bulletins.

questions.front: The complete set of statements; the income-statement subtotal chain; basic vs diluted EPS; comprehensive income and OCI
questions.back:
Complete set: balance sheet (point in time) | comprehensive income (1 or 2 statements) | changes in equity | cash flows | + NOTES (integral). MD&A is supplementary.
Chain: revenue − COGS = GROSS PROFIT − operating costs = OPERATING PROFIT (EBIT) ± financial items = EBT − tax = NET INCOME → NCI + parent. Consolidation: 100% of lines, control presumed > 50%.
BASIC EPS = common NI ÷ WEIGHTED-AVERAGE common shares (VW 6.8bn ÷ 0.295bn = €22.63). DILUTED = adjusted NI ÷ shares incl. hypothetical options/convertibles.
Comprehensive income = all equity changes EXCEPT owner transactions = NI + OCI (VW 11,638 + 2,305 = 13,943). OCI not reclassified: pension remeasurements; may be reclassified: FX translation, cash flow hedges.

questions.front: The equity roll-forward, the three cash-flow categories, the four-term cash reconciliation, and indirect vs direct
questions.back:
Ending equity = Begin + NI + OCI + issuance − dividends − buybacks (VW 92,910 + 13,943 + 3,481 − 1,332 + 75 = 109,077).
OPERATING: transactions determining net income. INVESTING: acquire/dispose long-term assets. FINANCING: obtain/repay capital (bonds, contributions, dividends paid). IFRS more flexible than US GAAP on interest/dividend classification.
Net change in cash = CFO + CFI + CFF + FX EFFECT (VW −1,185 − 16,508 + 17,625 − 727 = −796).
INDIRECT (start with profit, adjust) — almost all companies; DIRECT (gross receipts/payments) — very few. Ideal for an established firm: CFO is the primary source of cash. Financial flexibility = ability to react to adversity and opportunity.

questions.stem: Which of the following is most likely NOT an objective of financial statements?

choices.A: To provide information about the performance of an entity
choices.B: To provide information about the financial position of an entity
choices.C: To provide information about the users of an entity's financial statements

questions.explanation: NOT stem → T/F each. Statements provide information about the entity's financial position (T), performance (T) and changes in position TO users — they do not provide information ABOUT users (F → answer).
questions.kr: NOT 지문 → 선지별 T/F. 재무제표는 기업의 재무상태(T)·성과(T)·재무상태 변동에 관한 정보를 이용자'에게' 제공 — 이용자'에 관한' 정보는 제공하지 않음(F → 정답).

questions.stem: According to the Conceptual Framework for Financial Reporting, which of the following is NOT an enhancing qualitative characteristic?
questions.explanation: NOT stem → check each against the list. Enhancing = C-V-T-U: comparability (T), verifiability, timeliness (T), understandability. 'Accuracy' is not a characteristic at all — the curriculum's term is FAITHFUL REPRESENTATION (a fundamental characteristic), whose 'free from error' explicitly does not mean perfectly accurate. Two traps stacked: a NOT stem, and an off-model word that sounds like it belongs.
questions.kr: NOT 지문 → 목록과 대조. 보강적 특성 = C-V-T-U: 비교가능성(T), 검증가능성, 적시성(T), 이해가능성. '정확성'은 특성 자체가 아님 — 교재 용어는 '충실한 표현'(근본적 특성)이고, 그 '오류 없음'은 완벽한 정확성을 뜻하지 않음. 함정 두 개: NOT 지문 + 그럴듯한 교재 밖 단어.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT a constraint on the financial statements according to the Conceptual Framework?
questions.explanation: NOT stem → T/F each against the constraints list: (1) trade-offs/BALANCING among the qualitative characteristics (T), (2) the pervasive constraint — BENEFITS vs. COSTS (T), (3) non-quantifiable information is omitted. Understandability is an ENHANCING qualitative characteristic, not a constraint (F → answer). Category check first: is the option a characteristic or a constraint?
questions.kr: NOT 지문 → 제약 목록과 대조: (1) 질적 특성 간 '균형'(T), (2) 포괄적 제약 — 효익 대 원가(T), (3) 계량화 불가 정보 누락. 이해가능성은 '보강적 질적 특성'이지 제약이 아님(F → 정답). 먼저 범주 확인: 이 선지는 특성인가 제약인가?

questions.stem: The assumption that an entity will continue to operate for the foreseeable future is called:
questions.explanation: The framework's two underlying assumptions: ACCRUAL basis (transactions recorded in the period they occur, not when cash moves) and GOING CONCERN (the entity continues for the foreseeable future; one planning to liquidate or materially curtail needs different information). Comparability is an enhancing characteristic, not an assumption.
questions.kr: 개념체계의 두 기본 가정: 발생기준(현금 이동이 아니라 발생 기간에 기록)과 계속기업(예측 가능한 미래에 계속 영업; 청산·대폭 축소 예정이면 다른 정보 필요). 비교가능성은 보강적 특성이지 가정이 아님.

questions.stem: The assumption that the effects of transactions and other events are recognized when they occur, not when the cash flows occur, is called:
questions.explanation: Keyword TIMING ('when they occur, not when cash flows') → ACCRUAL basis: effects recorded in the periods to which they relate. Going concern = CONTINUITY. Relevance is a fundamental qualitative CHARACTERISTIC, not an assumption — the stem says 'assumption', so only two options are even in the right box.
questions.kr: 키워드 '시점'(현금 흐름이 아니라 발생할 때) → 발생기준: 해당 기간에 효과를 기록. 계속기업 = '지속성'. 목적적합성은 근본적 질적 '특성'이지 가정이 아님 — 지문이 '가정'이라 했으니 범주상 후보는 두 개뿐.

questions.stem: Neutrality of information in the financial statements most closely contributes to which qualitative characteristic?
questions.explanation: Faithful representation = complete + NEUTRAL + free from error (C-N-F). Relevance = predictive/confirmatory value + materiality. Understandability is an enhancing characteristic.
questions.kr: 충실한 표현 = 완전성 + '중립성' + 오류 없음(C-N-F). 목적적합성 = 예측가치/확인가치 + 중요성. 이해가능성은 보강적 특성.

questions.stem: Valuing assets at the amount of cash or equivalents paid, or the fair value of the consideration given, to acquire them at the time of acquisition most closely describes which measurement basis?
questions.explanation: Keywords: PAID + AT THE TIME OF ACQUISITION → HISTORICAL cost (past, entry side; includes acquisition costs; if not cash, fair value of what was given). Current cost = what you'd pay to buy it TODAY. Realizable value = what you'd RECEIVE by selling it. Read two things from the stem: when (then vs today) and which side (pay vs receive).
questions.kr: 키워드: '지급' + '취득 시점' → 역사적 원가(과거, 구입 측; 부대비용 포함; 현금이 아니면 지급한 대가의 공정가치). 현행원가 = '오늘' 구입한다면 지급할 금액. 실현가능가치 = 팔아서 '받을' 금액. 지문에서 두 가지를 읽는다: 언제(그때 vs 오늘), 어느 쪽(지급 vs 수취).

questions.stem: The valuation technique under which assets are recorded at the amount that would be received in an orderly disposal is:
questions.explanation: Keywords: RECEIVED + ORDERLY DISPOSAL → REALIZABLE value (today, sell side, undiscounted). Present value DISCOUNTS future cash inflows from using the asset in the normal course; current cost is what you'd PAY to buy it today.
questions.kr: 키워드: '수취' + '정상적 처분' → 실현가능가치(오늘, 판매 측, 할인 없음). 현재가치는 정상 영업에서 자산이 창출할 미래 현금유입을 '할인'; 현행원가는 오늘 구입 시 '지급'할 금액.
